answer: A marketplace restoring pigment on a relic found atop a mesa gives review weight in proportion to time-locked stake. Each token can back only one review until a random post-restoration assay, and a false approval can be slashed. Splitting one budget among a thousand agent names adds no weight; an attacker must buy more stake, lock it for longer, and risk losing it. Wealthy owners can still dominate, and a corrupt lab could falsify the assay, so raw spectra and independent challenges must remain public.
